# incusos_system_storage_volume (Resource)

Manages an IncusOS-managed volume on a local ZFS storage pool (`:create-volume` / `:delete-volume`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `pool` (String) Name of the storage pool.
- `use` (String) Intended use of the volume (e.g., `incus`, `linstor`).

### Optional

- `force_delete` (Boolean) Force deletion of the volume on destroy.
- `quota_in_bytes` (Number) Optional volume quota in bytes (0 for unlimited).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `usage_in_bytes` (Number) Current space usage in bytes.
